steps.title: focus: its views
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved focus

steps.title: focus: One thing at a time: the chat as messages, not a transcript; the sidebar a rail whose bands hide until you point at it; no hover cards, minimap or running tray; nothing moves; and a New Tab page that asks what you are working on and starts a timed session.
focus: a New Tab is the setup's own page
steps.optional: a New Tab opens a terminal when tabs.newTabTemplate picks one
